messages:
lee: FYI ap-south GPU warmpool failing to join since 10:12 UTC, lots of NotReady.
ana: autoscaler shows init stage failing on KMS decrypt -> `AccessDenied` and `connection reset`.
sam: I pushed firewall template `egress-tighten-v2` at 10:09, thought I included kms ranges but used old var.
infra-bot: policy apply detected fw-rule egress-tighten-v2 by sam at 2026-04-02T10:09:05Z.
lee: tcpdump from init pod shows `RST` to kms.ap-south-1 IPs.
ana: Quick mitigation: adding ephemeral SG egress to kms and sts endpoints (TCP 443) with 20m TTL.
sam: revert queued for the fw PR, but patching SG now to avoid more warmpool fallback to us-east.
security-bot: Logged SEC-2026-021; recommend Privatelink for KMS in ap-south and add egress smoke test.
lee: After allowlist, nodes start decrypting and joining. snippet from init logs:
```
2026-04-02T10:18:12Z init: KMS Decrypt -> 200
2026-04-02T10:18:13Z init: decrypted bootstrap token
2026-04-02T10:18:37Z join: node registered to pool-gpu-apc
```

ana: Cost note: fallback to us-east added ~2.4k USD/hr while degraded. finance tagged.
sam: Follow-ups I'll do: 1) update fw template to include mandatory KMS/ST S ranges 2) add CI lint to catch missing required services 3) open Privatelink request 4) add KMS egress check in canary pipeline.
lee: Opening INC-2026-082 for RCA and postmortem; adding logs and tcpdumps.
infra-bot: Revert of egress-tighten-v2 completed.
security-bot: Schedule design review for Privatelink next Tue.
lee: Thanks team. We'll attach postmortem to the incident and close after follow-ups done.
